assertions: Essex will take Reading: the town will fall into Parliament's hands, not hold out for the King
The town is delivered by surrender by its governor Sir Arthur Aston, rather than Essex being repulsed or raising the siege
The governor cannot sustain the defence: Saturn, lord of the 4th for the governor, in his fall, is too weak against Mars fortified and received by the Moon in the 10th near Regulus
No effective royal relief saves the town: the Sun, the King's significator, in the 7th in a fixed sign, does not prevent the delivery
There is a short stall or period of nothing perfected first, Moon void of course, before her application to Mars brings the matter to conclusion
The delivery comes swiftly within the April siege, by late April 1643, not after a long blockade lasting months

Essex's success is not costless or by overwhelming storm alone: Mars in his fall shows his army's weakness, and the taking is by delivery after encirclement despite the town still having some ammunition and provision (Jupiter lord of the 5th and Venus therein)
summary: Essex will take Reading, delivered by surrender of its weakened governor in late April after a brief stall, with no royal relief preventing it.
method: Lilly classical horary (whole-sign / classical horary siege rules): lord of Ascendant vs lord of 4th, dignities, reception, Moon's application
reasoning: Mars, lord of Scorpio Ascendant and significator of Essex, is well fortified and in reception with the Moon (Mars in her house, Moon in his terms and face, in the 10th near Regulus), outweighing Mars being in his fall. Saturn, lord of Aquarius 4th for the town/governor, is in his fall and therefore unable to hold. Moon void of course gives initial delay, then applying to Mars (sextile equivalent to square in signs of long ascension) perfects the matter to Essex. Sun, King's significator, in 7th in a fixed sign gives no rescuing aspect. Hence town taken by delivery/surrender, timeframe set by the siege scale to days-weeks in April (unit: days/weeks, via Moon's application to the Ascendant lord).
